description: This file contains a shell script defining the function 'platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk', which handles the upgrade process for a dual-boot setup on a device running OpenWrt firmware. The script manages partition selection, calculates checksums, updates U-Boot environment variables, and performs UBI volume updates.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_datachk
methods.description: Handles dual-boot upgrade process, managing partition selection, checksum calculation, updating U-Boot environment, and flashing new firmware volumes.
